title: A Place In The Sun
description: Have you ever heard of a fairy, more specifically, a creature that gives us dreams when we are asleep. Dreams that we desire. Ellrae’s wish is to find her happy place. For her, that place is the Dream Land. A land she built on her own, without the help of Sandman. However, was it that easy? ア・プレイス・イン・ザ・サン
